units.source_text: 她的父母呢，迎接公子来此之后，似觉年来祈愿已经成遂。

en.t: After welcoming the young lord here, her parents seemed to feel that the prayers they had offered for years had at last been fulfilled.

units.source_text: 但倘贸然将女儿嫁与，而结果公子看她不起，此时做父母的将何等悲伤！

en.t: But if they rashly gave their daughter to him in marriage, only for the young lord to look down on her, how deeply her parents would grieve then!

units.source_text: 如此一想，又觉深可担心。

en.t: Thinking of it in this way, they became deeply anxious again.

units.source_text: 对方虽是杰出之人物，但女儿倘做了弃妇，何等悲痛，何等不幸！

en.t: Though he was an exceptional man, if their daughter became an abandoned wife, how painful and unfortunate that would be!

units.source_text: 盲目信仰眼睛看不见的神佛，而不考虑对方的性情与女儿的宿命，真乃孟浪之举！

en.t: To put blind faith in unseen gods and Buddhas, without considering his character or their daughter's fate, would truly be a reckless act!

units.source_text: ——如此反复思量，但觉心迷意乱。

en.t: As they turned these thoughts over again and again, their hearts only grew more confused and unsettled.
